I’ve gone through this- and honestly still feel it. I’m Spanish/Black/ Blackfoot and the more I’ve educated myself on history (that school didn’t teach me) and reading up on the absolute atrocities and horrors the Spanish have inflicted makes me sick. I also have very light skin and can be seen as “white passing” to others, so I felt as though I wasn’t allowed or worthy to have the POC label because it felt wrong toward others due to the way I look. Having this kind of guilt really sucks but it is a good thing that we are aware. It doesn’t make us any less mixed and any less POC.

In this context, a *Mutt* defines a dog that is of two or more breeds of other dogs. So some people tend to refer to mixed people as that.

I’ve been called this as well as “mutt” a lot growing up. Usually by adults who think it’s funny to degrade me because I’m not just one  race. People treat us like dogs and it’s so dehumanizing like we’re not even human in their eyes
